crossRefs.note: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for…
For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you brought up my life from the…
There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…

translations.web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
translations.bsb: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?”
translations.kjv: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
translations.asv: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, When once there is rest in the dust.
